paragraphs: In [Ketubot 104a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.104a.22), R' Nachman bar Yitzchak said that Rav Yehudah bar Kaza recited in the baraita of Bar Kaza’s school.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak’s introduction, “Rav Yehudah bar Kaza taught in a baraita of the school of Bar Kaza.” The teaching continues on [104b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.104b.1).

תני is rendered recited/taught and מתניתא דבי בר קזא as baraita of Bar-Kaza’s-school. This does not independently establish a professional teacher role. Both Yehudah Rav occurrences are full; bare Bar Kaza gains no title.
